message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for the given facts.

Facts: Liu, due to economic dispute, went to victim's house, used a crowbar (撅头) and ladder, smashed the door and destroyed items: two TVs, a fridge, a water dispenser, a set of table and chairs, a tea table. Value 8817 yuan. After, they reached compensation agreement.

This is intentional destruction of property. The appropriate crime is "故意毁坏财物". In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "故意毁坏财物罪". The label used in examples: For similar case (first example) they gave "故意毁坏财物". Indeed the first example: "事实:湖北省十堰市... 造成物品损坏... A: 故意毁坏财物". So same.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物<eoa>

Check if any other crimes apply: maybe "故意毁坏财物" only. No other aspects like "抢夺" etc. So single label.
